description.value:
You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllChargChakra0]{Charge Chakra} focus spell. With a focus point and 1 to 3 actions, you regain a number of expended spell slots equal to the actions you spend, distributed across any ranks you can normally cast.

Like all focus spells, you can refresh your Focus Points by spending 10 minutes Refocusing. Your daily use cap on Charge Chakra is set by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves}.
